name: Hotel Mayura Gerusoppa Restaurant (KSTDC)
area: Jog Falls, near the main viewpoint
why_it_matters: The restaurant of the government-run KSTDC Hotel Mayura Gerusoppa — effectively the only proper sit-down dining within walking distance of the Jog Falls main viewpoint. Multi-cuisine menu leaning on Karnataka veg meals; the canteen near the Tunga block handles tea, breakfast and quick meals.
insider_tip: Reviewers describe the food as basic and the kitchen keeps a strict, early-closing schedule — eat at standard meal times, do not arrive late. With essentially nothing else around the viewpoint, plan meals around it or carry snacks. Cash and UPI; cards at the hotel desk.
signature_address: Hotel Mayura Gerusoppa, near Jog Falls main viewpoint, Jog Falls, Sagar Taluk, Shivamogga District, Karnataka 577435

name: Jog Falls Viewpoint Market Canteen
signature_dish: Hot snacks, akki rotti and chai
why_it_matters: The small market and canteen at the Jog Falls main viewpoint — the only quick-eat option for day visitors who do not want a full sit-down meal at the KSTDC hotel. Tripadvisor visitor reviews note the canteen food here is tasty and hygienic, useful before or after the climb down to the falls.
insider_tip: It is a basic viewpoint canteen and a cluster of stalls, not a restaurant — go for hot snacks, akki rotti and chai. Eat before the descent to the falls base; there is nothing at the bottom. Carry small notes; cash and UPI.
signature_address: Jog Falls main viewpoint market, Jog Falls, Sagar Taluk, Shivamogga District, Karnataka 577435

name: Sharavathi Adventure Camp Dining (Jungle Lodges)
area: Sharavathi valley, about 6 km from Jog Falls
signature_dish: Malnad-style meals with local fish and chicken
why_it_matters: The dining at Sharavathi Adventure Camp, a Jungle Lodges and Resorts property about 6 km from Jog Falls in the Sharavathi valley — a buffet-style operation serving all three meals, with locally sourced fresh fish and chicken cooked Malnad-style. One of the only places near Jog Falls to eat a proper regional meal.
insider_tip: This is a resort restaurant — meals are part of the JLR package and outside diners need to book ahead. Best taken as part of a stay or a planned camp visit, not a casual drop-in. Cards, UPI and cash at the reception.
signature_address: Sharavathi Adventure Camp, Sharavathi valley, near Jog Falls, Sagar Taluk, Shivamogga District, Karnataka 577435
